preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to your address. Alternatively, use rescueToken to steal any ERC20 tokens held by the contract. The owner can also manipulate fees, tax settings, and rebase functions to extract value from holders.
